controls.label: Show FPS
controls.help: Show the current frame rate in the game view.

controls.label: Keep window on top
controls.help:
Keep goThoom above other application windows. Fullscreen
already stays on top.

controls.label: Window Shadows
controls.help:
Show the shadow or glow defined by the theme around
floating windows and menus.

controls.label: Toolbar Placement
controls.help: Choose which list contains the toolbar.

controls.label: Window Layout
controls.help:
Open panel ordering, game placement, and
combined-message controls.

controls.label: Toolbar Info
controls.help: Show network and performance stats.

controls.label: Players
controls.help:
Show or hide this standalone window. Tiled mode manages
the main window visibility automatically.

controls.help:
Show or hide this standalone window. Tiled mode manages
the main window visibility automatically.

controls.label: Chat
controls.help:
Show or hide this standalone window. Tiled mode manages
the main window visibility automatically.

Show or hide this standalone window. Tiled mode manages
the main window visibility automatically.

controls.label: Reset Windows
controls.help: Restore the default window layout.

controls.label: Color Theme
Style Theme
controls.help:
Hover to preview control shapes and spacing. Click to keep
the style.

controls.label: Choose accent color
controls.help: Choose accent color

controls.label: Name Tag Label Colors
controls.help: Color name-tag borders by label.

controls.label: Smooth nametag motion
controls.help:
Move names and their health bars between pixels for
smoother motion. Text may look slightly softer; turn off for
crisp, pixel-aligned labels.

controls.label: Player Health Display
controls.help:
Color bar keeps names stable; Classic changes name color
as health falls.

controls.label: Show sharing icons in Players list
Show :smile: as emoji
controls.help:
Display names such as :smile: and :thumbs_up: as emoji in
chat and speech bubbles. Turn off to show the names as
written.

controls.label: Timestamp format
controls.help: mo,day,hour,min,sec,yr:01,02,03...

controls.label: Autocomplete
controls.help: Show input suggestions and let Tab complete them.

controls.label: Spellcheck
controls.help: Underline misspelled words and offer corrections.

controls.label: Bubble Lifetime
controls.help:
Classic: fixed 8 seconds. Modern: base seconds plus seconds
per word.

controls.label: Modern Base Life (s)
controls.help: Modern mode starts with this many seconds (default 3).

controls.label: Modern Life per Word (s)
controls.help: Modern mode adds this many seconds per word (default 1).

controls.label: Music SoundFont
controls.help:
Choose a valid .sf2 file from the Assets & Audio folder. The
list refreshes when opened.

controls.label: Audio Mixer
controls.help: Open the Mixer to adjust volume levels.

controls.label: Enhance sound effects
controls.help: Add ambience to newly played game sound effects.

controls.label: Stagger simultaneous sounds
controls.help:
Spread sound effects from the same game update across a
short interval.

controls.label: Simultaneous sound spread (ms)
controls.help: Total time from the first simultaneous effect to the last.

controls.label: Enhance bard music
controls.help: Add ambience to newly started bard music.

controls.label: Music Buffer (s)
controls.help:
Seconds of bard music prepared before playback. More
buffering tolerates slower SoundFonts but takes longer to
start.

controls.label: Throttle Repeated Sounds
controls.help:
Suppress the same effect when it repeats in adjacent server
updates.

controls.label: High quality resampling
controls.help:
Uses Lanczos resampling and dithering for cleaner audio at
higher CPU cost.

controls.label: Open Voices Folder
controls.help:
Open the piper/voices folder used for additional voice
models.

controls.label: Browse More Voices
controls.help:
Preview and download Piper voices. Install both the .onnx
model and its matching .onnx.json configuration file.

controls.label: Speech
controls.help: Speak ordinary player and NPC speech.

controls.label: Whispers
controls.help: Speak whispered messages.

controls.label: Yells
controls.help: Speak yelled and exclaimed messages.

controls.label: Thoughts
controls.help: Speak thought messages.

controls.label: Actions
controls.help: Speak player and world action messages.

controls.label: Ponders
controls.help: Speak ponder messages.

controls.label: Monster speech
controls.help: Speak monster messages.

controls.label: Your messages
controls.help: Speak messages sent by your current character.

controls.label: Notifications
controls.help: Speak in-game notification text when TTS is enabled.

controls.label: Click-to-toggle movement
controls.help:
Click once to keep walking toward the pointer; click again to
stop.

controls.label: Input bar always open
controls.help: Close for WASD and extra hotkeys.

controls.label: Quality preset
controls.help:
Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom
preserves individual choices.

controls.label: Artwork scale override
controls.help:
Fixed artwork texture scale. Default: 2x. Resizing the game
window does not change it. Higher values use more GPU
memory.

controls.label: Artwork upscale style
controls.help:
Crisp preserves hard edges; smoother modes blend more
neighboring pixels.

controls.label: Use sprite pack files
controls.help:
Replace compatible single-frame sprites from PNGs and
ZIPs in game or user-data hdimg folders.

controls.label: Obscuring Object Opacity
controls.help:
Lower values make covering artwork more transparent
while it is faded.

controls.label: Enable Sprite Gamma Correction
controls.help:
Compensates classic artwork for modern displays; disable if
colors look washed out.

controls.label: Sprite Gamma
controls.help:
Describes how brightness is encoded in the original sprite
artwork.

controls.label: Monitor Gamma
controls.help:
Describes the target display response used when correcting
sprite brightness.

controls.label: Smooth small moving objects
controls.help:
Attempt to smooth independently moving picture sprites
whose visible area is up to 35x35 pixels and moves no more
than 64 pixels between updates, such as coins. Requires
Smooth Motion.

controls.label: Subpixel movement
controls.help:
Keeps interpolated sprites at subpixel screen positions for
smoother movement. This can cause shimmering on some
artwork; turn it off to floor sprites to whole pixels.

controls.label: Character Animation Blend Duration
controls.help:
Set how much of the animation interval is spent blending
frames.

controls.label: World Animation Blend Duration
controls.help:
Set how much of the animation interval is spent blending
frames.

controls.label: Quality preset
controls.help:
Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom
preserves individual choices.

controls.label: Window Shadows
controls.help:
Show the shadow or glow defined by the theme around
floating windows and menus.

controls.label: Faster Character Shadows
controls.help:
Combines directional shadows into one cheaper layer
beneath characters and foreground artwork.

controls.label: Characters Receive Sun Shadows
controls.help:
Shade characters in proportion to how much another
character's projected shadow covers them.

controls.label: Mobile light-cone shadows (experimental)
controls.help:
Let mobiles cast experimental soft cone shadows from
nearby lights.

controls.label: Replacement Effects (experimental)
controls.help: Use procedural magic effects.

controls.label: Quality preset
controls.help:
Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom
preserves individual choices.

controls.label: Batch room artwork loading
controls.help:
Load missing room artwork in one pause instead of
spreading first-use work across frames.

controls.label: Sprite cache
controls.help:
Choose how much artwork to keep ready. The reserve
automatically scales with sprite resolution.

controls.label: Precache Sounds
controls.help:
Uses roughly 300 MB more RAM to avoid first-play sound
decoding delays.

controls.label: Show asset activity dots
controls.help:
Show activity dots in the game view's lower-right: green for
artwork decoding and processing, amber for audio
decoding, and red for GPU artwork uploads.

controls.label: Potato GPU (4096px Limit)
controls.help:
Use standalone textures instead of a large shared atlas for
GPUs limited to 4096x4096 textures. Artwork resolution and
upscaling are unchanged.

controls.label: Quality preset
controls.help:
Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom
preserves individual choices.

controls.label: Power save in background
controls.help: Reduce FPS when window is unfocused

controls.label: Always power save
controls.help: Limit FPS while focused.

controls.label: Limit to 250 FPS
controls.help:
When VSync is off and power saving is not active, cap the
client at 250 FPS.

controls.label: Power-save FPS
controls.help:
When power saving is active, sleep only enough to keep the
frame rate near this limit.

controls.label: VSync - Limit FPS
controls.help: Sync frame rate to the display.

controls.label: Enable NLSPT
controls.help:
Enable Network Latency & Server Phase Timing, which
learns the server frame phase and sends fresh input shortly
before its next processing window.

controls.label: NLSPT safety (%)
controls.help:
Minimum lead as a percentage of one server frame, with
frame jitter added separately. Session-only; resets to 10%
when goThoom starts.

controls.label: Edit Server List
controls.help: Add or remove server addresses used by the Login screen.

controls.label: File Paths
controls.help:
Choose alternate folders for assets and audio, logs, legacy
macros, and Go scripts.

controls.label: Open User Data Folder
controls.help:
Open the persistent folder containing settings, characters,
scripts, recordings, themes, and downloaded assets.

controls.label: Open Diagnostics Folder
controls.help:
Open the folder containing the current and rotated
diagnostic logs for bug reports.

controls.label: Setup Wizard
controls.help:
Reopen guided graphics, layout, controls, and audio setup
without resetting choices.

controls.label: Effect
controls.help: Show every effect in a gallery, or one effect at a larger scale.

controls.label: Display
controls.help:
Compare the original sprite animation with the procedural
replacement. This affects the preview only.

controls.label: Scale
controls.help:
Set the size of one selected effect. The all-effects gallery
always fits its tiles to the game view.

controls.label: Animation rate
controls.help:
Set the original sprite animation's updates per second. The
procedural effect stays smoothly animated between
updates.

controls.label: Reload Shaders
controls.help:
Recompile lighting and replacement shaders. Replacement
effects read this checked-out source tree.

controls.label: Close Preview
controls.help: Return the game view to its normal scene.

controls.label: Use tiled window layout

off to move and resize them freely.

controls.label: Snap floating windows
controls.help:
Align floating windows with nearby screen and window
edges while moving or resizing them.

controls.label: Combine chat + console
controls.help: Show chat and console output together in one pane.

controls.label: Auto-size side panels
controls.help:

resize them independently.

controls.label: Start with

Choose a starting arrangement, then move any pane in the
preview. Undo restores your previous arrangement.

controls.label: Even splits
controls.help:
Equalize paired panes. Centered layouts keep more space
for the game; the toolbar may require a wider pane.
